summary: V3-08 repair of trusted finalizer failure from Actions run 35617229931. The finalizer release job failed at step 'Android API 35 install, launch and golden path' (~18m58s) with all product/privacy/cost gates and the APK build passing. The candidate repairs the E2E golden-path blocker in scripts/e2e-android.js only: (1) a global cold-start grace (COLD_START_GRACE_MS = 450s, anchored to app launch time set in launch()) protects ALL waitFor calls during the initial launch phase, covering cold start, demo sign-in and initial screen rendering; previously only the Demarrer waitFor carried a per-wait grace, so the next waitFor (e.g. Appartement) fired the stuck-app detector during the 1-3 min SQLite demo sign-in, force-stopped a healthy app and cascaded into timeout exhaustion; (2) STUCK_APP_THRESHOLD raised 4 -> 8 (4-8 min before recovery after grace expiry); (3) _appLaunchTime is reset on every force-stop/relaunch path (crash detector, pidof exit 1, APP STUCK) so a relaunched app receives a fresh grace window. Trusted verification exit code 0: typecheck PASS, 453/453 tests PASS (22 suites), privacy 71/71 PASS, cost 21/21 PASS, expo export android PASS, prebuild PASS, :app:assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL. Independent re-verification confirms tsc exit 0, jest 453/453 PASS, privacy PASS, cost PASS, node --check and bash -n PASS, and the v3-08-finalizer-wrapper contract suite 23/23 PASS. Delta scope is exactly one file (scripts/e2e-android.js, +38/-3); no product code, governance, directives, workflows or release state touched; no chrono/premium/paywall/warm-V2 regression terms introduced. All previously accepted V3-01..V3-07 invariants preserved. Decision: accept.

findings.problem: Trusted finalizer run 35617229931 failed at the Android API 35 emulator golden-path step after ~18m58s; all product/privacy/cost gates and the APK build passed.
